steps: Peel and core 2 apples, then grate them finely on a box grater.
Heat canola oil in a medium non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the grated apple and cinnamon; cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until soft and no liquid remains.
Toast 4 slices of whole wheat bread until golden, then cut each slice into 3 fingers.
Spread ricotta evenly over each toast finger, about 1 tablespoon per finger.
Spoon the warm cooked apple over the ricotta, dividing it evenly.
Serve immediately; yields 12 fingers · 4 family portions. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 1 day.
